mapper.select: select 'HDM00001' as orgId, card_no as jobNo, id_card_no as certificateNo, emp_name as name, 1 as personType, 111 as certType, 0 as sex, phone_no as mobile, case when (life_photo is not null and life_photo != '') then life_photo else id_photo end as faceUrl, case when (delete_falg = 1 or state = '2') then '-1' else '0' end as status from safety.safety_black_message where update_time between #{start} and #{end}

select 'ZZRY0001' as orgId, emp_no as jobNo, emp_no as certificateNo, emp_name as name, 1 as personType, 131 as certType, case when (sex is null or sex = '') then 0 when (sex = '0') then 1 when (sex = '1') then 2 else 0 end as sex, phone_no as mobile, photo as faceUrl, 0 as status from safety.safety_employee_message where update_time between #{start} and #{end}

select 'BA000003' as orgId, fd_phone as jobNo, fd_phone as certificateNo, fd_name as name, 1 as personType, 990 as certType, 0 as sex, fd_phone as mobile, fd_img as faceUrl, 0 as status from safety.safety_enter_register where update_time between #{start} and #{end}

select 'FK000002' as orgId, visitor_phone as jobNo, visitor_phone as certificateNo, visited_name as name, 1 as personType, 990 as certType, 0 as sex, visitor_phone as mobile, photo as faceUrl, 0 as status from safety.safety_visitor_hairpin where delete_falg = 0 and vendor_state in (1, 5, 8, 9, 10, 11) and update_time between #{start} and #{end}
